title: Ajuru-Curau
summary: AJU'RU-CURAU, noun An American parrot, of a lively green color, with a blue crown; the throat, and sides of the head, of a fine yellow.

inlines.v: AJU'RU-CURAU, noun An American parrot, of a lively green color, with a blue crown; the throat, and sides of the head, of a fine yellow.
